### Cross-domain sign test [DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- INVALID BY CONSTRUCTION]

delta_proxy = frozen CE - wikitext mean is confounded by intrinsic domain entropy (e.g. code has far lower frozen ppl than wikitext, so its 'shift' is hugely negative while its adaptation gains are the largest). Kept only to document why the C6 design moved within-domain; NOT used for the gate.

- (ln; stop = alta when present else last fixed step) fit on ['wikitext', 'code'] (acc 1.0000, thr 0.0000), eval on ['legal', 'pubmed']: accuracy = 0.8500 on 40 docs (would-be 0.7 gate: yes)
  - legal: 0.9500 (n=20)
  - pubmed: 0.7500 (n=20)

Metric-design lesson (feeds the paper's limitations section): loss-based delta proxies are confounded by intrinsic domain entropy; representation-distance proxies (E5 hidden-state shift, delta_v2) recover the theory's prediction.
